question: Can a public pre-shock price history, with anonymous total executed volume as a negative-control extension, narrow the one-step response to the named benchmark shock within a declared finite candidate catalog?

transition.rule: Keep the existing deterministic transition unchanged. Only the observation map and declared candidate filtering vary.

candidate_grid.role: illustrative finite catalog, not an inferred market distribution

P0.timing: after the final prelude transition and before the named shock

P1.timing: initial mark plus one mark after each completed pre-shock transition

P2.timing: volume is recorded only after the same completed pre-shock transition as its mark

wide.interpretation: synthetic matching bands around noiseless traces; not estimates of exchange feed error

response_comparison.rule: responses disagree when next marks differ by more than the fixed next-mark tolerance or forced-sale occurrence differs
response_comparison.independence: observation matching bands never alter either response threshold

intervention.name: benchmark_100_to_98
intervention.timing: after the complete prelude and before exactly one response transition

truth_cases.construction: all 18 candidate configurations crossed with both preludes
truth_cases.primary_observer_scope: all 36 possible histories without candidate_id or prelude_id
truth_cases.known_path_diagnostic: only the 18 histories sharing the truth case prelude; privileged scenario knowledge

matching_rules.fieldwise: every observed field must match within its own absolute band
matching_rules.subset_invariant: for a fixed catalog and setting, P2 compatible histories must be a subset of P1, which must be a subset of P0
matching_rules.band_monotonicity: wider observation bands cannot remove a history compatible under the exact setting

predeclared_negative_control.claim: P2 compatible sets should equal P1 compatible sets for both declared preludes and both observation settings
predeclared_negative_control.reason: under the frozen preludes anonymous total volume adds no separation beyond the public price history
predeclared_negative_control.failure_action: audit the adapter and deduction before interpreting any response result

interpretation_limits: All spans are conditional on the declared finite catalog and are not confidence intervals.
The primary observer does not receive candidate or prelude identity.
The known-path diagnostic uses privileged scenario knowledge and must remain separately labeled.
The benchmark path is hidden from the primary observer; the final 100 to 98 change is a declared intervention applied after the history.
The wide bands are synthetic matching tolerances around noiseless traces, not an exchange-noise model and not a robustness guarantee over every perturbation.
Anonymous total executed units contain no trader attribution.
No empirical data are used, no model is fitted, and no trading-edge claim is made.
This protocol does not revise MFSM-RE-1, MFSM-RE-OBS-1, or any empirical protocol.
